create.name: Rudy Peirce
create.bio:
Rudy Peirce is a gentle yoga teacher and teacher trainer from the Berkshires of Massachusetts who has been part of the Kripalu tradition for more than four decades. He arrived at Kripalu as a resident staff member in 1982, qualified as a Kripalu Yoga teacher the following year and was soon training other teachers himself, going on to lead dozens of trainings; Kripalu now counts him among its Legacy Faculty. He holds a master's degree and Kripalu's 1,000-hour certification, and has also trained as an Ayurvedic yoga teacher.

Over the years he has shaped his own approach, Dynamic Gentle Yoga, which keeps the movements simple and slow and offers choices at every stage, so that people who doubt they can do yoga at all can take part and still arrive at real stillness and meditation. For many years he and his wife, Joyce, travelled to studios along the East Coast; in 2020 they moved their teaching online and founded Gentle Yogis, a small online studio with a daily breath and gentle movement class followed by community reading and conversation. He also mentors gentle and chair yoga teachers, records guided practice audio and leads retreats at Kripalu and abroad.

courses.title: Gentle Yoga Retreat: Cultivate Presence, Resilience, and Renewal
courses.description: A weekend at Kripalu in Stockbridge, Massachusetts, where Rudy leads Kripalu Gentle Yoga as a form of moving meditation. Sessions combine slow postures, breathing and rest with attention to inner experience, and are open to every level of strength and flexibility.

courses.title: Kripalu Gentle Yoga Teacher Training
courses.description: A five-day residential training at Kripalu, led by Rudy, for teachers who already hold a 200-hour certificate. It refines the skills needed to guide gentle classes well, from pacing and options to clear cueing, and ends with a plan for reaching new students.

courses.title: Breath & Gentle Movement
courses.description: The studio's signature live class on Zoom, held every morning at 8am Eastern: about forty minutes of gentle spinal movement and four breathing techniques, done seated. An optional community hour follows, with a shared reading and conversation.
courses.price: $15 USD per class (or by pass or membership)

courses.title: Gentle Yoga Teachers Circles
courses.description: Two-hour online gatherings on selected Sundays where Rudy mentors gentle and chair yoga teachers. A graduate of his training leads a practice, then the group reflects on methods such as option-based guiding and meditative pacing; a replay is included.

courses.title: All Access Yoga Membership
courses.description: A monthly household membership to Gentle Yogis covering every live online class, the Saturday immersion workshops and the full video library of recordings. Smaller memberships and a ten-class pass are also offered, and new students can try a free month.

courses.title: The Gentle Series
courses.description: Four guided audio practices by Rudy that can be used in any order. Each one moves through easy stretching and strengthening, simple breathing, relaxation and a short meditation; the set is delivered digitally.

Availability set to worldwide: all his regular classes are online; the PO box in Housatonic, MA is a postal address, not a studio. He also teaches in person at Kripalu nearby, so local_online would be arguable.
